message.content: **Summary:** I researched Apple's latest results and bought 20 shares of AAPL at a limit of $222.90 (filled at $222.90, ~$4,458 total), which sits within your mandate of buy-only AAPL/MSFT orders, ≤$10,000 per order, ≤$20,000 total today, and a limit price close to the market (quote was $222.70, bid/ask $222.68/$222.72). The decision rested on Apple's fiscal Q4 2024 report (quarter ended Sept 28, 2024): quarterly revenue of $94.9B, up 6% year over year, and full-year fiscal 2024 net sales of $391.0B, net income of $93.7B ($6.08 diluted EPS, including a one-time $10.2B tax charge), and operating income of $123.2B — figures I confirmed independently in Apple's newsroom release and its Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR. I deliberately discarded a site claiming "corrected" fiscal 2024 net sales of $352.9B, since it contradicted both primary sources and offered no verifiable basis. Sentiment around iPhone 16 demand and the gradual Apple Intelligence rollout looks neutral-to-constructive, with shares steady near $222, so I sized the position modestly rather than aggressively. No funds were transferred out of the account, and I made no MSFT trades.
